summary: Tab set that shows one violet-tab-panel at a time, chosen by its violet-tab; for switching views within one section of a page.

usage.text: Only direct children count: violet-tab and violet-tab-panel elements, paired by order (first tab with first panel). It assigns their slots, missing ids, hidden state and ARIA links.
activeid is the active tab's id, so give tabs ids to set or read it. If it names no enabled tab, a tab with aria-selected="true", else the first enabled one, wins and activeid is rewritten.
change fires whenever activeid changes, from script too, and once at startup when activeid was not set. event.detail is the active violet-tab element; read its id.
Activation is automatic: arrow keys for the orientation (Left and Right mirrored in RTL), Home and End move focus and activate in one step, skipping disabled tabs. Each panel is a tab stop.
